title.zh: 神经与带状疱疹：前顶、头部腧穴的解剖、针感四要求与面瘫的分期辨经
title.en: Nerve Disorders and Herpes Zoster: Qianding, Scalp-point Anatomy, Four Demands on De Qi, and Staged Channel Differentiation of Facial Palsy

summary.zh: 这一章的絮语从一次带状疱疹的偶然发现讲起，引出前顶、后顶、百会三穴的区别，再谈头部穴的解剖特点(层浅、脉细、要搓针、针尖到骨膜上)和他的针感四要求(定位准、找有反应的穴、深度、传导方向与长度)；面瘫部分强调早期先辨经、先治乳突部炎症、禁针面部，并按风寒(太阳经)、风热(阳明经)分类。
summary.en: The essays begin with a chance finding in herpes zoster and lead to what separates Qianding, Houding and Baihui, then the anatomy of scalp points (shallow, fine vessels, cuo needling, tip down to the periosteum) and his four demands on needling sensation (accurate location, a reactive point, depth, direction and length of transmission). On facial palsy he stresses early channel differentiation, treating mastoid inflammation first, avoiding the face early, and sorting by wind-cold (Taiyang) and wind-heat (Yangming).

takeaways.zh: 前顶清热解毒的发现：一位38岁男子小腹、阴部严重带状疱疹，住院1周抗炎、维生素、止痛无效，走路时两腿要叉开。他诊断为肝胆湿浊热毒，单针前顶、做搓针法后疼痛明显减轻、即刻能正常走路，走了一段时间再搓针1次，疼痛完全消失。前顶位于囟会往后循摸矢状缝上的凹陷处，离囟会的距离因人的解剖而异。
takeaways.en: How Qianding's heat-clearing, detoxifying action was found: a 38-year-old man had severe zoster on the lower abdomen and genitals and, after a week of anti-inflammatory, vitamin and analgesic treatment in hospital, could not walk without spreading his legs. He diagnosed liver-gallbladder damp-turbid heat toxin, needled Qianding alone with cuo technique, and pain eased markedly so that he could walk normally at once; after walking a while a second cuo needling removed the pain completely. Qianding lies in the depression on the sagittal suture found by palpating backward from Xinhui, its distance from Xinhui varying with individual anatomy.

takeaways.zh: 后顶、百会、前顶三穴各管一类：三穴都在颅骨上，针刺相对安全。前顶与百会皆能升清，但前顶还能补气清热；后顶能温经散寒、舒筋通络、行气止痛、活血化瘀。后顶治肌腱韧带病变(筋出槽、位移、痉挛)；百会治内脏下垂、阳气下陷(气短、久泄、脱肛、尿频)；前顶升清降浊，可改善脑部血液循环，清醒头脑，对中风后遗症的头昏沉、记忆差也常用。他说这些理论认识只是“初步的”。
takeaways.en: Houding, Baihui and Qianding each cover a different area: all three lie on the skull, so needling is relatively safe. Qianding and Baihui both raise the clear, but Qianding also supplements qi and clears heat; Houding warms channels and dispels cold, relaxes sinews, moves qi to relieve pain and invigorates blood. Houding treats tendon and ligament lesions (sinew out of groove, displacement, spasm); Baihui treats organ prolapse and sunken yang (shortness of breath, chronic diarrhoea, rectal prolapse, frequent urination); Qianding raises the clear and lowers the turbid, improves cerebral circulation and clears the head, and is often used for post-stroke muddled head and poor memory. He calls this understanding only preliminary.

takeaways.zh: 头部穴的解剖决定针法：《内经》说发际内的穴多为“脉气所发”；头部没有肌肉、层次不深，经脉气较浅，在皮筋之间，血供分散细小。因此头皮针刺必须用搓针，深度要合适，针尖到骨膜上、筋膜下，不能太浅；头皮薄的人容易刺到皮浅层，疼而效果差。
takeaways.en: Scalp anatomy dictates the needling: the Neijing calls many points inside the hairline places where 'channel qi issues'; the head has no muscle and few layers, so channel qi is shallow, between skin and sinew, and the blood supply is scattered and fine. Scalp needling therefore needs the cuo technique at a suitable depth, the tip down to the periosteum beneath the fascia, not too shallow; in thin scalps it is easy to hit the superficial skin layer, which hurts and works poorly.

takeaways.zh: 针感四要求决定疗效：一，准确定位——穴皆在缝隙里，位置不准则理解病机再好、选经配穴再适当也没有针感、没有疗效；二，取对症候有明显反应的穴(酸痛、结节，或能使症候改变)；三，针刺深度——同一穴在不同人、不同时段、不同季节或身体状态得气深度都不同，须靠提插去找；四，针感传导的方向和长度——每穴方向不同，长度要求一样，传得越远效果越好。
takeaways.en: Four demands on needling sensation decide the effect. One, accurate location: points lie in gaps, and if the position is off, however good the pathomechanism and point combination there is no sensation and no effect. Two, choose points that react clearly to the symptom (sore, nodular, or able to change the symptom). Three, depth: the de qi depth of one point differs between people, times, seasons and body states and must be found by lifting and thrusting. Four, direction and length of transmission: each point has its own direction, but the length demand is the same, and the further it travels the better.

takeaways.zh: 面瘫要靠察经，不能只想阳明：本部分4位周围性面瘫患者病因、病程不同——李某以太阳经为主伴阳明经，徐某以少阳、阳明经为主且由带状疱疹引起，金某以太阳、少阳、阳明经，王某以阳明、少阳经并累及厥阴经。他说这说明经络诊察非常重要。
takeaways.en: Facial palsy needs channel palpation, not a reflex to Yangming: the four peripheral-palsy patients in this section differed in cause and duration; Li mainly Taiyang with Yangming, Xu mainly Shaoyang and Yangming and caused by zoster, Jin Taiyang, Shaoyang and Yangming, Wang Yangming and Shaoyang involving Jueyin. He says this shows how important channel palpation is.

takeaways.zh: 早期先治乳突部，不要急于局部取穴：发病前期有乳突部疼痛时，先察乳突部的太阳经、少阳经(天柱、玉枕、完骨、风池、脑空，个别在风府、大椎)；治急性乳突炎症以患侧乳突部穴为主，禁用面部穴，可在太阳经井穴放血；他认为很多慢性面瘫后遗症是医生忽视乳突发炎，造成面神经营养障碍所致，发病越短恢复越快。“先治急性炎症”，疼痛消失或缓解后才取局部穴。
takeaways.en: Treat the mastoid first in the early stage and do not rush to local points: when mastoid pain is present early, palpate the Taiyang and Shaoyang channels at the mastoid (Tianzhu, Yuzhen, Wangu, Fengchi, Naokong, occasionally Fengfu and Dazhui); for acute mastoid inflammation use mainly points of the affected mastoid, avoid facial points, and the Taiyang jing-well may be bled. He holds that many chronic sequelae arise because the doctor ignored mastoid inflammation, starving the facial nerve, and that the shorter the onset the faster the recovery. Treat the acute inflammation first; take local points once the pain has gone or eased.

takeaways.zh: 面瘫按病因分类选经：中枢性(多见脑血管病)在脑血管病控制后可自愈，可取通里、照海通脑络；针灸科常见的是周围性，病因分风寒和风热。风寒大多侵太阳经(并可牵连少阳)；风热多为病毒感染、以阳明经为主。风热早期浅刺额部穴(患侧头维、颔厌)，在患侧商阳放血清热解毒，针患侧合谷、曲池、足三里，恢复期以面部穴为主。
takeaways.en: Facial palsy is sorted by cause. Central palsy (mostly cerebrovascular) recovers by itself once the vascular disease is controlled, and Tongli and Zhaohai may be used to open the brain collaterals; peripheral palsy is what acupuncturists usually see, caused by wind-cold or wind-heat. Wind-cold mostly attacks the Taiyang channel (and can involve Shaoyang); wind-heat is usually viral and mainly Yangming. In wind-heat, early on needle the forehead shallowly (affected-side Touwei, Hanyan), bleed Shangyang on the affected side to clear heat and detoxify, needle Hegu, Quchi and Zusanli on that side, and in recovery use mainly facial points.

title.en: Table 2. Facial palsy: type, stage and points

rows.zh: 脑血管病控制后可自我恢复；可取通里、照海，通脑络
rows.en: Recovers itself once the vascular disease is controlled; Tongli and Zhaohai open the brain collaterals

rows.zh: 周围性·风寒(疲劳时受风寒)
先察乳突部：天柱、玉枕、完骨、风池、脑空；太阳经井穴放血；虚加患侧太阳经原穴；可取患侧通天、曲差；风寒加灸大椎；禁用面部穴
rows.en: Palpate the mastoid first: Tianzhu, Yuzhen, Wangu, Fengchi, Naokong; bleed the Taiyang jing-well; add the affected-side Taiyang source point if deficient; affected-side Tongtian, Qucha; moxa Dazhui for wind-cold; avoid facial points

rows.en: Facial points once mastoid pain is gone

rows.zh: 乳突胀痛取最敏感的穴(天柱、风池、玉枕、脑空)；浅刺额部穴(头维、颔厌)；患侧商阳放血；合谷、曲池、足三里(足三里可血罐)；禁针面部
rows.en: For mastoid swelling take the most sensitive points (Tianzhu, Fengchi, Yuzhen, Naokong); shallow forehead points (Touwei, Hanyan); bleed affected-side Shangyang; Hegu, Quchi, Zusanli (Zusanli may be cupped for blood); avoid the face

how_to_use.zh: 头部穴先按表1区分三穴的方向(后顶治筋、百会升阳、前顶升清降浊)，再按“头部解剖”的要求用搓针、针尖到骨膜上；每穴都按针感四要求检查一遍。面瘫先看是中枢还是周围、是风寒还是风热，早期先处理乳突部，恢复期再取面部穴(表2)。
how_to_use.en: For scalp points first separate the three by direction (Houding for sinew, Baihui for lifting yang, Qianding for raising clear and lowering turbid), then needle with cuo to the periosteum as his anatomy requires, checking each point against the four demands. For facial palsy decide central or peripheral, wind-cold or wind-heat, deal with the mastoid first, and use facial points only in recovery (Table 2).

caveats.zh: 前顶的作用和三穴比较是他自称“初步的”认识，来自个人临床观察。原文“卤会”“失状缝”“领厌”即囟会、矢状缝、颔厌(OCR或原用字)，“太阳经井穴”未说明手足；“周围性面瘫约占95%以上”一句在OCR中被页眉打断，此处未引用数字。带状疱疹的前顶病例是一例的印象，不是系列统计。
caveats.en: The actions of Qianding and the three-point comparison are, in his words, preliminary, drawn from personal clinical observation. 卤会, 失状缝 and 领厌 in the source are Xinhui, the sagittal suture and Hanyan (OCR or the author's spelling); 'Taiyang jing-well' is not specified as hand or foot; the '95% or more' figure for peripheral palsy is interrupted by a page header in the OCR and is not quoted here. The zoster case for Qianding is a single-case impression, not a series.
